title: Is This Failed Actor Nepo Baby Now the Biggest Media Mogul Ever?
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In tonight's edition, I take a deep dive into how
David Ellison went from a wannabe actor who starred in a box office bomb that
his daddy financed to one of the biggest media tycoons in history - and what
that means for the rest of us. Also, are CNN staffers being prematurely
optimistic about the fate of the network under Ellison? And why won't Fox air
Trump's rallies? Plus, I look at the horrific mainstream media coverage of
Israel's genocide in Gaza.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

* * *

# **He Couldn 't Act. So He Became a Media Mogul Instead**

Did you know that a 20-year-old movie that pulled in less than a quarter of
its $60 million budget at the box office and holds a[ Rotten Tomatoes
score](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/flyboys) of just 34% would become the
catalyst for one of the largest mass-media consolidations in recent memory?

Of course, it would probably make a little more sense if I pointed out that
one of the stars of that film was a 23-year-old nepo baby [trust fund
kid](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/david-ellisons-journey-trust-
fund-100056217.html) making his acting debut only after his obscenely wealthy
father, who is now [the eighth-richest man in the
world](https://www.forbes.com/real-time-billionaires/), put up[ a huge chunk
of cash](https://www.wired.com/2008/04/larry-ellisons/) to help him fund the
project.
